profile_text.body:
Diffit is a teacher-facing tool for adapting content and creating differentiated resources, which the company describes as helping all students access grade level content. According to its site, teachers use it to adapt material and build resources at different reading levels.

The product tracked is Diffit, listed under education and research AI. It generates leveled readings, summaries and questions from a topic or source text. Its stated audience is teachers, and the vendor states it does not collect student data, that it complies with FERPA and COPPA, and that it never sells data. Pricing is a free version for teachers with a 60 day premium trial, and school site licenses priced by enrollment.
